labor_shifts_hours_present_check.name: labor_shifts_hours_present_check
labor_shifts_hours_present_check.value: "labor_shifts"."scheduled_hours" is not null or "labor_shifts"."actual_hours" is not null

labor_shifts_non_negative_hours_check.name: labor_shifts_non_negative_hours_check
labor_shifts_non_negative_hours_check.value: ("labor_shifts"."scheduled_hours" is null or "labor_shifts"."scheduled_hours" >= 0) and ("labor_shifts"."actual_hours" is null or "labor_shifts"."actual_hours" >= 0)

observability_events_non_negative_check.name: observability_events_non_negative_check
observability_events_non_negative_check.value:
("observability_events"."duration_ms" is null or "observability_events"."duration_ms" >= 0)
        and ("observability_events"."rows_imported" is null or "observability_events"."rows_imported" >= 0)
        and ("observability_events"."input_tokens" is null or "observability_events"."input_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("observability_events"."output_tokens" is null or "observability_events"."output_tokens" >= 0)
        and ("observability_events"."cost_micros" is null or "observability_events"."cost_micros" >= 0)

recipe_ingredients_exactly_one_target_ch.name: recipe_ingredients_exactly_one_target_check
recipe_ingredients_exactly_one_target_ch.value:
(
        ("recipe_ingredients"."ingredient_item_id" is not null and "recipe_ingredients"."sub_recipe_id" is null)
        or
        ("recipe_ingredients"."ingredient_item_id" is null and "recipe_ingredients"."sub_recipe_id" is not null)
      )
